title: Slow Click Closed
h1: 8× slow click · no highs · a small dead room
vars: The slow click with nothing above 800 Hz, in a small dead room: short, dark, close.
Nothing above 500 Hz, a 42 Hz thump underneath, the room a little wetter.
The 8× click with a 16× copy under it, nothing above 600 Hz. One hit, two depths.
The slow click and click 4 slowed, 140 ms apart, both under 500 Hz, with weight.
After-rattle under 400 Hz in the deadest room, with a faint 50 Hz hum that cuts off at 0.9 s, like a pressure leaving.
12× slow, nothing above 350 Hz, 38 Hz weight, a tiny room, the hum cutting off. The most closed of the six.
